focus: The five loading options, five fields each (steer iteration 2)
noveltyJustification: First consolidated five-option matrix with every field cited or UNKNOWN; adds the reset-semantics mismatch between the two dedup precedents and measured card-size bounds.

statement: Option 1 (status quo): resident 6.8k tokens; per-window fixed loads (router 3.0k, brief 65, notice 138) plus variable rule loads (6.2-8.2k per 3-4 fire event; reply pair 4.6k); silence = nothing fires / read-only turns; dedup model-side only, hooks mechanical; reaches Claude+Devin resident, six runtimes for the brief.

Option 2 (cards resident in AGENTS.md): +2,509 B (index form) to +17,882 B (full card proxy); zero per-turn; full text on demand 1.4-3.0k/file; silence model-mediated; reset at compaction; verified delivery only Claude and Devin; exact card size UNKNOWN.

Option 3 (Gate 5 loads cards): 0 resident; per-fire matched cards 0.7-1.8k tokens vs 6.2-8.2k today (~70-80% reduction); silence = no trigger match; model-side dedup only; reaches every runtime Gate 5 reaches.

Option 4 (hook injects cards once per window): 0 resident; 234-446 tokens per card per window; silence on no match + post-delivery suppression + kill switches; dedup via directive lifecycle (full on boundaries/shrink) or spec-gate marker (session-scoped); delivery machinery on all six runtimes but dedup proof needs session identity + transcript evidence, UNKNOWN for most runtimes.
Option 5 (load everything): 145,957 B / ~36.5k tokens per load; no silence; no mechanical dedup; reaches any file-reading runtime but competes with working context everywhere.

Reset-semantics mismatch: only the directive lifecycle matches the steer's 'reset only on a compaction boundary' shape (transcript shrink + compact event + epoch advance); the spec-gate marker is session-scoped with different reset events (gate re-open, resume, failed bind).
The 16,384-byte delivery cap observed in this runtime constrains resident-card options: additions past the cap compete with the file tail for one delivery budget.
Card-size bounds measured: index-summary form 2,509 B total; full card proxy 17,882 B total (935-1,784 B per rule); drafted card size remains UNKNOWN.
